## Summary

Fixes a race in the Sepo preview workflow where a non-preview `pull_request.labeled` event, such as the automatic `agent` label, can cancel an in-progress valid preview deployment and then skip its own deploy job.

The workflow-level concurrency group is moved to job-level concurrency on the actual `deploy` and `teardown` jobs, so skipped jobs from ignored label events do not acquire the preview concurrency group or cancel active preview runs.

## Test plan

- [x] `actionlint .github/workflows/preview.yml`
- [x] Verified PR #66 failure mode: `opened` preview run was cancelled by an `agent` label run, and the label run skipped because it was not `sepo-preview`.
title: Fix preview cancellation on non-preview labels
